detail: New repo for settlement-truth XRP forecasting, separate from the live forecast site.
Surveyed arXiv/q-fin, Kaggle, open-source harnesses. Credible ceiling: AUC 0.52-0.55 with free data. Ranked methods: reversal, multi-timeframe, clock effects.
Kalshi public API: every 15-min window strike + outcome back to Jul 31, 2026. Base up-rate 51.4%.
Coinbase public API, full history to match the settlement windows.

decision: LEAK CAUGHT: candle timestamp fencepost error
detail: First training run showed AUC 0.79 — impossible. Root cause: Coinbase timestamps mark bucket STARTS; features were peeking 5 min into the window. Fixed alignment; honest AUC 0.55.
Walk-forward OOS (1-day embargo, 3,360 windows): AUC 0.552, accuracy 54.1%, Brier skill +1.0%. 21 features, isotonic calibration, 50% shrinkage.
Kitron & Wengrowicz idea: gate reversal on volume intensity. OOS AUC 0.548 vs 0.552 champion. No gain; kept the simpler model.
Binance geo-blocked, Kraken has no free funding history. Cannot backtest honestly — left out.
arXiv, Ivy League repos, PhD theses (Sao Paulo, Edinburgh, Southampton). Confirmed approach; skepticism log updated.
Forecast ledger + auto-scorer + weekly champion/challenger + weekly literature scan. All autonomous.
forecast-runner and score-ledger collided pushing to data branch. Added pull --rebase before push.
